$schema_note: Coverage audit of MODEL.xlsx for the 128 current players flagged NO_PREVIOUS_PL_PLAYER_RATE_HISTORY in the baseline_9c8c8edce88e593d gap table. This is not a golden-parity extraction like the five prior BENCHWARMERS_*_NOTES sessions -- it is a read-only investigation into whether the workbook contains ANY usable previous-season player-rate data for these specific gap players, matched strictly by player_code. No workbook, Python source, test, or existing documentation file was modified.
extraction_method: openpyxl, read-only (read_only=True). Cached resolved values read via data_only=True; formula text read via a separate data_only=False load of the same file. Window offsets were re-read fresh from CONTROL this session rather than assumed from a prior extraction's recorded values, then independently sanity-checked against David Raya's already-published LF/SF figures before being applied to the 128 gap players.

workbook.note: size_bytes/mtime_iso/sha256 are identical to every prior Benchwarmers extraction session recorded in this repository, confirming the workbook has not been touched since the last read-only session and was not touched by this one.

baseline_lineage.note: Same baseline run recorded in docs/research/preseason_baseline_gap_audit_2026_27.json, re-queried fresh this session against the live DuckDB file rather than trusted from the prior JSON alone.

database_query.sql: SELECT fpl_id, player_code, team_id, data_quality_flags FROM baseline_projection_gap WHERE model_run_id = 'baseline_9c8c8edce88e593d' ORDER BY fpl_id

validation_against_audit_targets.category_derivation: player_status_snapshot.team_join_date joined by fpl_id against the same source_ingestion_run_id, then partitioned per docs/research/preseason_baseline_gap_audit_2026_27.json's own rule: OWN_TEAM_PROMOTED_PRIOR flag present -> promoted_team_player; else team_join_date >= 2026-06-01 -> summer_arrival_existing_pl_team; else -> returning_or_development_player.

player_code_partition.note: 'Workbook row present' means the player_code was found via a direct code match against column A of the MINS/xG/xA/DC/PL pivot-table blocks (rows 1003-1999, i.e. the block MODEL!PT CODE ROW MATCH resolves against). All five sheets were independently scanned and agreed on presence/absence for every one of the 128 codes -- zero disagreement cases were found, so there is no sheet-by-sheet split to report.

coverage_taxonomy_and_counts.note: Five-way taxonomy requested by the task, applied to all 128 gap players. Counts below are exhaustive and sum to 128.

workbook_row_absent.definition: player_code not found by direct match against column A of MINS!A1003:A1999 (and, independently confirmed, xG/xA/DC/PL agree on absence for the same code in every case -- zero disagreements across the five sheets for any of the 128 codes). This is the block MODEL!PT CODE ROW MATCH (=MATCH(code, MINS!$A$1001:$A$1999, 0)) searches; if the code is absent here, PT CODE ROW MATCH would itself return #N/A and every downstream LF/SF formula would hit its IFERROR-to-zero fallback. Not written to the CSV.

workbook_row_present_but_provider_minute.definition: player_code found in MINS/xG/xA/DC/PL, but every long-form and short-form minutes/rate figure resolves to exactly 0 -- true for ALL 111 present-row players, with zero exceptions. Written to the CSV with numeric 0 values (the workbook's own genuine cached zero, not a substituted placeholder) and flagged WINDOWED_RATE_PROVIDER_MINUTES_ZERO / WINDOWED_DEFCON_PROVIDER_MINUTES_ZERO in source_coverage_flags.

psapi_lookup_absent_or_ambiguous.definition: player_code not found in PSAPI[code] (an exact MATCH-based lookup, so 'ambiguous' never actually occurs here -- MATCH either finds exactly one row or none; no case of multiple PSAPI rows sharing one code was found). True for ALL 111 exported players -- PSAPI coverage is precisely zero for this entire gap set, which is the structurally expected result since PSAPI is a previous-Premier-League-season table and every one of these 128 players is, by the gap definition itself, a player without previous-PL history. season_minutes/season_starts/season_saves/season_yellow_cards/season_red_cards/season_bonus/season_bps are left BLANK (not zero) in the CSV for these rows, flagged PSAPI_LOOKUP_ABSENT.

genuine_observed_zero_with_positive_sour.definition: A player whose LF or SF minutes are positive (proving the underlying pivot-sheet window is genuinely populated with matches) but whose corresponding xG/xA/DefCon rate is exactly zero -- i.e. a real, evidenced zero rather than an absent-data zero. None found: every one of the 111 present-row players has LF minutes = SF minutes = 0, so there is no case in this gap set where positive minutes coexist with a zero rate. This category exists in the taxonomy but has zero members for this specific 128-player set.

formula_or_cache_error.definition: Any cached cell value that is an Excel error string (#VALUE!, #REF!, #N/A, etc.) rather than a number, anywhere in the PSAPI row or the MINS/xG/xA/DC windowed cells for any of the 128 gap players. An exhaustive scan of every relevant field for all 128 players found zero such values -- the workbook's universal IFERROR-to-zero convention (documented in all five prior BENCHWARMERS_*_NOTES extractions) means a lookup failure surfaces as a clean 0, not a propagated error, for every field used in this export.

coverage_taxonomy_and_counts.sum_check: 17 + 111 = 128 (workbook_row_absent + workbook_row_present); of the 111 present rows, all 111 are simultaneously provider-minutes-absent AND psapi-absent -- these are not mutually exclusive counts, they describe the same 111 rows from two different angles (windowed-rate coverage and season-total coverage).

source_field_map.note: Header/formula/cell provenance for every CSV field, resolved from the live workbook this session, not assumed from memory or a prior extraction.

player_code.source: baseline_projection_gap.player_code (DuckDB, from the FPL snapshot), used as the join key into the workbook
player_code.workbook_join_target: MINS!A1003:A1999 / xG!A1003:A1999 / xA!A1003:A1999 / DC!A1003:A1999 / PL!A1003:A1999 / PSAPI[code] (each an independent exact-code match, per sheet)

source_field_map.player_name: MINS/xG/xA/DC/PL sheets carry no player-name column at this row block (only code in column A); player_name in the CSV is the FPL current-season web_name already resolved in baseline_projection_gap's joined player_snapshot, not a workbook-sourced field, to avoid a name-based workbook join.
source_field_map.position: Same as player_name: sourced from the current FPL snapshot's fpl_position, not from a workbook name lookup.

season_starts.note: MODEL!'PS Starts' does NOT use this field -- it uses 'Previous Season Starts1', a name-matched blend of PSPT[Starts] across 4 aliases (FPL_Name/web_name/FBRef_Name/Alt Name 2). Per this task's explicit 'match by player code only, do not use names as a runtime join' instruction, season_starts is sourced from PSAPI[starts] (code-matched) instead of MODEL's own name-matched column. This is a deliberate deviation from replicating MODEL's exact formula chain, made because the task's join-method constraint takes precedence over formula-for-formula parity. Documented in detail in the O'Shea audit and the NOTES.md companion.

long_form_minutes.row_block: A1003:CZ1999 (per-GW delta values keyed by code in column A)
long_form_minutes.window: 25-26-GW01 through 25-26-GW38 inclusive (38 columns, index 3-40 within B1001:CZ1999)
long_form_minutes.model_analog_formula: =IFERROR(SUM(INDEX(MINS!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$D$56+1-CONTROL!$C$56):INDEX(MINS!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$E$56)),0)

long_form_expected_goals.model_analog_formula: =IFERROR(SUM(INDEX(xG!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$D$56+1-CONTROL!$C$56):INDEX(xG!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$E$56)),0)

long_form_expected_assists.model_analog_formula: =IFERROR(SUM(INDEX(xA!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$D$56+1-CONTROL!$C$56):INDEX(xA!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$E$56)),0)

short_form_minutes.model_analog_formula: =IFERROR(SUM(INDEX(MINS!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$D$57+1-CONTROL!$C$57):INDEX(MINS!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$E$57)),0)

long_form_defcon_minutes.window: identical column range to long_form_minutes -- verified this session that CONTROL!B83/C83/D83/E83 (DefCon LF window) are numerically identical to B56/C56/D56/E56 (attacking LF window), so LF DefCon minutes and LF attacking minutes are the same 38-GW window over the same MINS sheet.

long_form_defensive_contribution.model_analog_formula: =IFERROR(SUM(INDEX(DC!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$D$83+1-CONTROL!$C$83):INDEX(DC!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$E$83)),0)

short_form_defcon_minutes.window: 25-26-GW29 through 25-26-GW38 inclusive (10 columns, index 31-40) -- the DefCon-specific 10-GW short window (CONTROL!B84=10), distinct from the 6-GW attacking short window.

short_form_defensive_contribution.model_analog_formula: =IFERROR(SUM(INDEX(DC!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$D$84+1-CONTROL!$C$84):INDEX(DC!$B$1001:$CZ$1999,MODEL[[#This Row],[PT CODE ROW MATCH]],CONTROL!$E$2-CONTROL!$E$84)),0)

source_field_map.source_coverage_flags: Not a workbook field -- a JSON array assembled by this extraction from the presence/absence and zero/nonzero findings above, plus the promoted/summer-arrival/returning category. Possible values: PSAPI_LOOKUP_ABSENT, WINDOWED_RATE_PROVIDER_MINUTES_ZERO, WINDOWED_DEFCON_PROVIDER_MINUTES_ZERO, PROMOTED_TEAM_PLAYER, SUMMER_ARRIVAL_EXISTING_PL_TEAM, RETURNING_OR_DEVELOPMENT_PLAYER.

control_window_offsets.note: Re-read fresh this session, not reused from the prior team-strength or CS/GC extraction sessions' recorded values, though they are structurally the same mechanism.

E2.meaning: current-season-GW column pointer into the shared MINS/xG/xA/DC/PL header row

control_window_offsets.docs_data_model_cross_check: docs/DATA_MODEL.md states 'long form: GW1--38; attacking short form: GW33--38 (six gameweeks); DefCon short form: GW29--38 (ten gameweeks)'. All three resolved windows above match exactly.

raya_sanity_check.purpose: Before trusting the window-offset arithmetic on any of the 128 gap players, the identical mechanism was verified against David Raya (player_code 154561), whose LF/SF figures are already published in docs/research/benchwarmers_appearance_reference.json and this session's own MODEL-sheet formula read.
raya_sanity_check.pt_code_row_match_verification: MODEL!PT CODE ROW MATCH for Raya = 58 (cached). Independently confirmed MATCH(154561, MINS!A1001:A1999, 0) = 58, and MINS row 1058 (=1001+58-1) column A = 154561. The join mechanism used for all 128 gap players is the same direct code-column scan, not a re-derivation of MATCH's internal behavior.

findings: PSAPI[code]=216616 lookup: ABSENT. Confirmed by scanning all 841 PSAPI data rows -- no row has code 216616. This means every PSAPI-sourced field (season_minutes, season_saves, season_yellow_cards, season_red_cards, season_bonus, season_bps in this CSV; MODEL!PS Mins/PS Saves/PS YCs/PS RCs/PS Bonus/PS BPS in the live workbook) resolves to the IFERROR fallback of 0 in MODEL, and to BLANK (not 0) in this CSV per the task's explicit instruction not to convert a missing lookup into an observed zero.

PT CODE ROW MATCH = 534 -- a VALID row index, confirmed by direct lookup: MINS row 1003+534-1=1536, column A = 216616. This is NOT an IFERROR-triggered fallback from a failed MATCH; O'Shea's code genuinely exists in the MINS/xG/xA/DC/PL row-1001 block.

Despite the valid row, every windowed sum is exactly 0: long_form_minutes=0, long_form_expected_goals=0, long_form_expected_assists=0, short_form_minutes=0, short_form_expected_goals=0, short_form_expected_assists=0, long_form_defcon_minutes=0, long_form_defensive_contribution=0, short_form_defcon_minutes=0, short_form_defensive_contribution=0. Re-verified via a completely fresh, independent workbook read after the CSV was written (see re_verification section) -- zero mismatch.

MODEL!'Previous Season Starts1' (NOT used by this export) resolves to 46 for O'Shea via a NAME-matched lookup into PSPT[Starts] on FPL_Name specifically (columns EL/EM/EN via web_name/FBRef_Name/Alt Name 2 all return 0; only the FPL_Name alias, column EK, matches). This 46-start appearance history is real and separately confirmed working (it is the number the earlier goals/assists and CS/GC extractions cited), but it is sourced by a NAME join, not a CODE join, so per this task's explicit code-only-join instruction it is NOT carried into season_starts in this CSV. season_starts is instead left blank, consistent with PSAPI's own code-matched absence, and both facts are recorded rather than silently reconciled.
oshea_audit.conclusion: O'Shea's row is present in the windowed-rate block but every provider-sourced attacking/DefCon figure is a genuine zero because the underlying Understat-derived MINS/xG/xA/DC pivot data has no entries for him, and he is additionally absent from PSAPI (previous-PL season totals) entirely -- both are provider coverage gaps, not evidence of zero playing time or zero ability. His real previous-season starts (46) are recoverable only through a name-matched lookup that this export deliberately does not use, so the CSV correctly shows him as fully missing on season_* fields despite that number existing elsewhere in the workbook under a different join method. This refines (rather than contradicts) the finding already recorded in docs/research/BENCHWARMERS_SAVES_CARDS_BONUS_DEFCON_NOTES.md and BENCHWARMERS_GOALS_ASSISTS_NOTES.md: this session additionally confirms the PSAPI season-total gap exists independently of, and in addition to, the already-documented MINS/xG/xA/DC windowed-rate gap.

re_verification.method: After the CSV was written, a completely fresh openpyxl load of the workbook (new load_workbook() calls, independent of the extraction script's in-memory state) re-scanned MINS/xG/xA/DC and re-looked-up PSAPI for a 6-player sample: the first exported row, the last exported row, the middle exported row, three additional deterministic picks, and O'Shea specifically (7 unique codes after de-duplication).
re_verification.result: All sampled CSV values matched a completely independent fresh read of the live workbook exactly.

3_no_fabricated_zeros.note: Verified: every row with PSAPI_LOOKUP_ABSENT has empty-string season_* fields in the CSV, confirmed by direct CSV parse.

4_no_dead_code_join.note: player_code used as the sole join key against every workbook sheet (PSAPI, MINS, xG, xA, DC, PL); player_name/position sourced from the already-code-joined FPL snapshot, not re-derived from a workbook name lookup.

unresolved_ambiguities_not_guessed: Why the 17 excluded players are entirely absent from MINS!A1001:A1999 (and xG/xA/DC/PL agree) while the other 111 gap players at least have a row there (with all-zero values) -- both groups are current 2026-27 FPL players without previous-PL history, so row presence/absence does not obviously correlate with any FPL-side attribute checked in this session. Not resolved from the read-only extraction alone; would require inspecting how the underlying MINS/xG/xA/DC/PL pivot source data (an external Understat-derived feed, per the prior saves/cards/bonus/DefCon extraction) is populated upstream of this workbook.

Why PSAPI has zero rows for any of the 128 gap players even though PSAPI is described elsewhere in the workbook as the previous-season (2025-26) API-season-totals table -- this is the structurally expected result for players without 2025-26 Premier League minutes, but this extraction did not independently verify PSAPI's population rule (e.g. whether it is filtered to Premier-League-only appearances, or to players who were on a 2025-26 FPL squad list at all) beyond observing that Raya (a returning PL player) is present and all 128 gap players are absent.

Whether the MINS/xG/xA/DC pivot source data could ever be populated for a promoted-team or Championship player under a different provider or a later data refresh -- this extraction only establishes the current cached state, not the provider's future coverage plans.

The exact meaning of O'Shea's PSPT-sourced 46 starts relative to genuine 2025-26 Championship playing time is not re-derived here; it is reported only as an existing, name-matched figure this export deliberately excludes for join-method reasons, not as a verified alternative playing-time prior.
